title: External AI Data Sources: Elasticsearch, Azure AI Search and PostgreSQL | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Not all knowledge lives in your site's content index. Some of it is in a search index that another system maintains, or in a database table. A CrestApps AI data source can read an Elasticsearch index, an Azure AI Search index or a PostgreSQL table where it is, keep a knowledge base in step, and let an assistant answer from it.

In this video:
• Why an external data source reads knowledge where it already lives
• What every source shares: a connection, a destination index and a field mapping
• Creating an Elasticsearch data source, and asking a question its index answers
• The Azure AI Search data source form
• The PostgreSQL data source form
• Use cases for external sources

chapters.title: An Azure AI Search data source
